# Skillchip Station
The skillchip station is a neural interface chair that fits and pulls skillchips for whoever is sitting in it. It is the only way to get a chip into or out of a brain.
## Building one It is a standard machine: build a machine frame, drop in the circuit board, and add the parts.
The board is printed at a circuit imprinter once the [color=#a4885c]Skill Implantation[/color] node has been researched, which lives in the service side of the research tree.
## Interface Shows the chip in the tray (name, effect, capacity cost), every chip already in the seated patient's brain, and a capacity bar for that patient.
## Implanting Drag the patient onto the chair to seat them, put a skillchip in the tray by clicking the chip on the station with it in hand, then open the interface and press [color=#a4885c]Implant[/color]. The procedure takes 15 seconds and the chip is used up.
## Removing Open the interface with the patient seated and press [color=#a4885c]Remove[/color] next to the chip you want out. Removal also takes 15 seconds, and the chip is [color=#993333]destroyed in the process[/color].
